Great questions, thanks for the clear list. I attached a first-draft MAP (AcmeData_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks the pilot and procurement steps into milestones with owners. High-level answers inline below and we can iterate quickly:

- AWS Private Offer: Yes — we can work with the AWS Marketplace team to publish a Private Offer tied to your account. Billing typically flows via consolidated billing (your payer account) and you can still receive a monthly invoice from Redwood; AWS will route payment to Redwood per the Private Offer terms.
- Azure Marketplace: Publisher registration and validation add ~2–4 weeks; some customers see an extra week for legal review. Billing via Azure is possible but requires publisher setup and invoice reconciliation work on both sides.
- GCP Marketplace: handled differently (SaaS/Commit billing); we can provide a quote and discuss the GCP billing connector if you prefer that route.

I’ll loop in Karthik for procurement specifics and Marissa for marketplace ops. I attached the draft MAP (spreadsheet) for your team to review — it has suggested dates that meet your pilot target.

3) We push a Private Offer on AWS and provide DocuSign SOW/Order for signature.

If the timeline holds, we can meet your June 25 pilot target.

Thanks for the ping. Quick procurement notes based on our marketplace playbook:

- AWS Private Offer: Confirmed — we can accept purchase through AWS Private Offer. Process: Redwood creates offer, AWS creates Private Offer tied to AcmeData's account ID, Acme issues PO to AWS or Redwood depending on setup. Payment is processed by AWS; Redwood receives settlement from AWS per AWS terms. We typically provide a monthly invoice to customers and reconciliation reports on request.

- Billing language: Use the canonical clause we keep in the marketplace order form (I pasted suggested wording into the MAP spreadsheet under the "Billing Path" tab). Short version: customer is billed by AWS per Private Offer; Redwood invoices for any out-of-band services (professional services, dedicated capacity) per signed SOW.

- Azure Marketplace: Publisher registration required — plan for +2–4 weeks for validation. If Acme needs immediate procurement, AWS is the faster path.

- GCP Marketplace: GCP has different settlement timing; if they want GCP we should surface that early.

I also flagged a potential legal ask: Acme procurement may request NET45 payment terms. Our default is NET30; if they need NET45 we'd want commercial approval (Vivek).

I reviewed the MAP and adjusted milestone owners and added AWS contacts for offer creation.

Karthik
